purpose: Freeze each B3-approved named baseline before C1 collection. This record is a research binding, not a promotion, installation, or paper-trial authorization.

calibration.calibration_source: B2 continuation policy; raw score is the frozen score.
calibration.change_owner: B2 only; any corrective calibration requires development/validation data and a new model/policy version.

thresholds.source: B2 development out-of-fold threshold for this exact replacement artifact.

setup_definition.definition: FRVP S5 LVN Burst: bullish displacement with the nearest LVN within 0.30 ATR; the detector fires only on a newly eligible condition and the selected candidate is retained by the frozen detector priority/confidence rule.

policy.installation: research binding only; do not install or rewrite the deployed policy.

calibration.change_owner: B2 only; any corrective calibration requires development/validation data and a new model/policy version.

setup_definition.definition: ICT premium/discount continuation: trend-aligned short pullback into the premium/discount structure with a supportive FVG or order block within 0.75 ATR, no disqualifying recent opposite structure flip within three bars, and the selected causal detector event.

policy.installation: research binding only; do not install or rewrite the deployed policy.

collection_rules.audit_evidence_treatment: September audit near-misses and tiny hourly samples remain descriptive diagnostics. They cannot alter thresholds, setup definitions, calibration, policy gates, or the primary collection window.

calibration_controls.primary_calibration: Use each baseline's frozen B2 method; both approved continuation baselines are uncalibrated (none).
calibration_controls.allowed_data: development/validation or out-of-fold data only, with a new artifact, calibration hash, policy version, and replay evidence.
calibration_controls.forbidden_data: C1/new evaluation outcomes, September audit markouts, hourly buckets, near-misses, or any prospective result.
calibration_controls.promotion_effect: A calibration change creates a new candidate version and does not silently modify this freeze.

non_approved_scope.new_family_model_setup_gate: separate experimental variant only; not part of either approved baseline or its historical deployed policy

change_control.required_replay: A changed model, calibrator, threshold, setup matcher, detector, or policy requires a new B2/B4 version and must not be compared as the frozen baseline.
